frozen.providerPolicy: public settings fixture only; same fixture policy across modes

exact.traceMeasurementNote: observedResolverExtractionBudgetCounter is the maximum of emitted cumulative counter snapshots, not a physical extractor or HTTP request count; zero snapshots do not mean no extraction when logical extraction_start events are present. Shared lookup events are joined only when one native operation owns the lookup; ambiguous consumers are left unassigned.

note: Failures remain in attempt denominators; p95 is withheld unless >=20 measured timing samples. Trace fields count allowlisted logical events and observed resolver counter snapshots only; they do not represent HTTP request totals. Concurrent phase duration samples are not additive. Per-attempt RSS is omitted because available child RSS is a lifetime high-water mark.
